question: Apical meristem is present in which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plants**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Apical meristems are regions of actively dividing cells in plants, found at the tips of roots and shoots.
 
• They are responsible for primary growth, which increases the length of the plant.
 
• Apical meristems give rise to various tissues and organs of a plant.
 
• These meristems help in the elongation of roots and shoots, aiding in the plant's ability to reach light and absorb nutrients.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meristematic Tissue:**

 
 
• Meristematic tissues are regions in plants where cells are continuously dividing.
 
• These tissues are found in zones of the plant where growth can take place, such as the tips of stems and roots.
 
 
 
• **Types of Meristems:**
 
 
• **Apical Meristem:** Located at the tips of roots and shoots, responsible for primary growth.
 
• **Lateral Meristem:** Found along the sides of stems and roots, responsible for secondary growth, increasing the thickness.
 
 
 
• **Primary Growth vs. Secondary Growth:**
 
 
• **Primary Growth:** Involves the elongation of the plant body, facilitated by apical meristems.
 
• **Secondary Growth:** Involves the thickening of the plant body, facilitated by lateral meristems such as the vascular cambium and cork cambium.
 
 
 
• **Role of Apical Meristems:**
 
 
• They are crucial for the formation of new leaves and flowers.
 
• They help the plant in adapting to its environment by growing towards light and water sources.
